name: facebook/metro/nightly-tests
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * *'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 1
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.4
      
      - name: Run yarn install
        uses: ./.github/actions/yarn-install
        with:
          no-lockfile: 'true'
      
      - name: Run Jest Tests
        run: yarn test
